{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793107860905,"sessionID":"ses_e827197a6ffegiwS8t1qb4ORn1","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"toolu_01RTCLQqJMknEvDDBhrqP9Dt","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"D=\"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5\"; cat \"$D/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt\"; echo ----; cat \"$D/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\"; echo ----; cat \"$D/common/hash.hpp\"; echo ----; cat \"$D/common/results_output.hpp\""},"output":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE -O3 -march=native -Wall -Wextra)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall m)\n----\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate operations per second\n    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793108055339,"sessionID":"ses_e827197a6ffegiwS8t1qb4ORn1","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01QHZtJHNWJE7zLWsTsMVSse","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp","content":"#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr unsigned int INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Tiled GPU Floyd-Warshall configuration.\n// Each thread block is TILE x TILE_Y threads; every thread owns ROWS_PER_THREAD\n// rows of a TILE x TILE tile.\nconstexpr int TILE = 32;\nconstexpr int TILE_Y = 8;\nconstexpr int ROWS_PER_THREAD = TILE / TILE_Y;\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                          \\\n    do {                                                                          \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_));                                    \\\n            exit(EXIT_FAILURE);                                                   \\\n        }                                                                         \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// GPU Floyd-Warshall (blocked / tiled formulation).\n//\n// Row-major storage: cell (i, j) lives at index i * n + j.\n//\n// The k-loop of the classic algorithm is split into rounds of TILE pivots.\n// Each round K runs three kernels:\n//   Phase 1: diagonal tile (K,K), sequential over its pivots.\n//   Phase 2: tiles (K,t) (row panel) and (t,K) (column panel).\n//   Phase 3: all remaining tiles (I,J), fully independent.\n//\n// Within a round the pivots are applied in increasing k, and every update uses\n// exactly the values the sequential algorithm would see at that step. The\n// values that the sequential algorithm reads from the pivot row and pivot\n// column at step k are snapshotted into colBuf / rowBuf when they are current,\n// so phase 3 can consume them without racing with later pivots. As a result the\n// distance and path matrices are identical to the reference sequential code.\n//\n// colBuf[r * TILE + k] = D_{k-1}[r][kb + k]   (pivot column k, seen at step k)\n// rowBuf[k * n + c]    = D_{k-1}[kb + k][c]   (pivot row k, seen at step k)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// Phase 1: diagonal tile (K,K).\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TILE * TILE_Y)\nfwPhase1(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n         unsigned int* colBuf, unsigned int* rowBuf,\n         size_t n, size_t kb, int bs) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int s[TILE][TILE];\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n\n    if (tx < bs) {\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < bs) s[i][tx] = dist[(kb + i) * n + kb + tx];\n        }\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < bs; ++k) {\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < bs && tx == k) colBuf[(kb + i) * TILE + k] = s[i][k];\n            if (i == k && tx < bs) rowBuf[k * n + kb + tx] = s[k][tx];\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < bs && tx < bs) {\n                const unsigned int cand = s[i][k] + s[k][tx];\n                if (cand < s[i][tx]) {\n                    s[i][tx] = cand;\n                    path[(kb + i) * n + kb + tx] = kb + k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n        if (i < bs && tx < bs) dist[(kb + i) * n + kb + tx] = s[i][tx];\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2: row panel tiles (K,t) and column panel tiles (t,K), t != K.\n// blockIdx.y == 0 -> row tile, blockIdx.y == 1 -> column tile.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TILE * TILE_Y)\nfwPhase2(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n         unsigned int* colBuf, unsigned int* rowBuf,\n         size_t n, int K, size_t kb, int bs) {\n    const int t = blockIdx.x;\n    if (t == K) return;\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sC[TILE][TILE];\n    __shared__ unsigned int sK[TILE][TILE];\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t t0 = static_cast<size_t>(t) * TILE;\n\n    if (blockIdx.y == 0) {\n        // Row tile: rows are pivot-block rows (i < bs), columns are tile t.\n        const int cl = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), n - t0));\n        if (tx < cl) {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n                const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n                if (i < bs) sC[i][tx] = dist[(kb + i) * n + t0 + tx];\n            }\n        }\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < bs && tx < bs) sK[i][tx] = colBuf[(kb + i) * TILE + tx];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (int k = 0; k < bs; ++k) {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n                const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n                if (i == k && tx < cl) rowBuf[k * n + t0 + tx] = sC[k][tx];\n            }\n\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n                const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n                if (i < bs && tx < cl) {\n                    const unsigned int cand = sK[i][k] + sC[k][tx];\n                    if (cand < sC[i][tx]) {\n                        sC[i][tx] = cand;\n                        path[(kb + i) * n + t0 + tx] = kb + k;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < bs && tx < cl) dist[(kb + i) * n + t0 + tx] = sC[i][tx];\n        }\n    } else {\n        // Column tile: rows are tile t, columns are pivot-block columns (j < bs).\n        const int rl = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), n - t0));\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < rl && tx < bs) sC[i][tx] = dist[(t0 + i) * n + kb + tx];\n        }\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int k = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (k < bs && tx < bs) sK[k][tx] = rowBuf[k * n + kb + tx];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        for (int k = 0; k < bs; ++k) {\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n                const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n                if (i < rl && tx == k) colBuf[(t0 + i) * TILE + k] = sC[i][k];\n            }\n\n            #pragma unroll\n            for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n                const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n                if (i < rl && tx < bs) {\n                    const unsigned int cand = sC[i][k] + sK[k][tx];\n                    if (cand < sC[i][tx]) {\n                        sC[i][tx] = cand;\n                        path[(t0 + i) * n + kb + tx] = kb + k;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            __syncthreads();\n        }\n\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            if (i < rl && tx < bs) dist[(t0 + i) * n + kb + tx] = sC[i][tx];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 3: all tiles (I,J) with I != K and J != K. Fully parallel.\n__global__ void __launch_bounds__(TILE * TILE_Y)\nfwPhase3(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path,\n         const unsigned int* colBuf, const unsigned int* rowBuf,\n         size_t n, int K, size_t kb, int bs) {\n    const int J = blockIdx.x;\n    const int I = blockIdx.y;\n    if (I == K || J == K) return;\n\n    __shared__ unsigned int sA[TILE][TILE];  // sA[i][k] = D_{k-1}[r0 + i][kb + k]\n    __shared__ unsigned int sB[TILE][TILE];  // sB[k][j] = D_{k-1}[kb + k][c0 + j]\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t r0 = static_cast<size_t>(I) * TILE;\n    const size_t c0 = static_cast<size_t>(J) * TILE;\n    const int rl = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), n - r0));\n    const int cl = static_cast<int>(min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), n - c0));\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n        if (i < rl && tx < bs) sA[i][tx] = colBuf[(r0 + i) * TILE + tx];\n        if (i < bs && tx < cl) sB[i][tx] = rowBuf[i * n + c0 + tx];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    unsigned int v[ROWS_PER_THREAD];\n    unsigned int p[ROWS_PER_THREAD];\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n        if (i < rl && tx < cl) {\n            const size_t idx = (r0 + i) * n + c0 + tx;\n            v[r] = dist[idx];\n            p[r] = path[idx];\n        } else {\n            v[r] = 0;\n            p[r] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int k = 0; k < bs; ++k) {\n        const unsigned int b = sB[k][tx];\n        #pragma unroll\n        for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n            const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n            const unsigned int cand = sA[i][k] + b;\n            if (cand < v[r]) {\n                v[r] = cand;\n                p[r] = kb + k;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    #pragma unroll\n    for (int r = 0; r < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++r) {\n        const int i = ty + r * TILE_Y;\n        if (i < rl && tx < cl) {\n            const size_t idx = (r0 + i) * n + c0 + tx;\n            dist[idx] = v[r];\n            path[idx] = p[r];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Runs blocked Floyd-Warshall on the GPU. dist and path are updated in place\n// with the same results as the sequential algorithm.\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) return;\n\n    const size_t cells = numNodes * numNodes;\n    const size_t bytes = cells * sizeof(unsigned int);\n    const int numTiles = static_cast<int>((numNodes + TILE - 1) / TILE);\n\n    unsigned int *dDist = nullptr, *dPath = nullptr, *dCol = nullptr, *dRow = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dCol, numNodes * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dRow, numNodes * TILE * sizeof(unsigned int)));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dDist, dist.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPath, path.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const dim3 block(TILE, TILE_Y);\n    for (int K = 0; K < numTiles; ++K) {\n        const size_t kb = static_cast<size_t>(K) * TILE;\n        const int bs = static_cast<int>(std::min(static_cast<size_t>(TILE), numNodes - kb));\n\n        fwPhase1<<<1, block>>>(dDist, dPath, dCol, dRow, numNodes, kb, bs);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        fwPhase2<<<dim3(numTiles, 2), block>>>(dDist, dPath, dCol, dRow, numNodes, K, kb, bs);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        fwPhase3<<<dim3(numTiles, numTiles), block>>>(dDist, dPath, dCol, dRow, numNodes, K, kb, bs);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dist.data(), dDist, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(path.data(), dPath, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dCol));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dRow));\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n\n    // Create the CUDA context before timing so one-time driver setup is not\n    // counted as computation time.\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(nullptr));\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate operations per second\n    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n"},"output":"Wrote file {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793108060130,"sessionID":"ses_e827197a6ffegiwS8t1qb4ORn1","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01LCMLmtTyhMCFrzXF1rZv5Z","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","content":"cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)\nproject(floydwarshall_benchmark LANGUAGES CXX CUDA)\n\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)\nset(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)\n\n# Target the GPU(s) present at build time unless the user overrides it.\nif(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES)\n    set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native)\nendif()\n\n# The benchmark is GPU-parallelized with CUDA, so the source is compiled by nvcc.\nset_source_files_properties(floydwarshall.cpp PROPERTIES LANGUAGE CUDA)\n\nadd_executable(floydwarshall floydwarshall.cpp)\n\n# Enable optimizations (host code is forwarded to the host compiler via -Xcompiler)\ntarget_compile_options(floydwarshall PRIVATE\n    $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:-O3 -Xcompiler=-march=native -Xcompiler=-Wall -Xcompiler=-Wextra>)\n\n# Link math library\ntarget_link_libraries(floydwarshall m)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt","time":{"start":1793108060088,"end":1793108060098}},"metadata":{"anthropic":{"caller":{"type":"direct"}}},"id":"prt_17d91a5ad001dmpDVpc7pRRqIM","sessionID":"ses_e827197a6ffegiwS8t1qb4ORn1","messageID":"msg_17d9195200013Uhf11Ky52FEAk"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793108081312,"sessionID":"ses_e827197a6ffegiwS8t1qb4ORn1","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01R8hvjrzaTPtMbDvkBy5MG1","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/fwtest/equiv.cu","content":"#define main fw_bench_main\n#include \"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/floydwarshall_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_cuda_r5/floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp\"\n#undef main\n#include <random>\n\nstatic void refFW(std::vector<unsigned>& dist, std::vector<unsigned>& path, size_t n) {\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k)\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i)\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n                const unsigned dIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, n)];\n                const unsigned nd = dist[idx2(k, i, n)] + dist[idx2(j, k, n)];\n                if (nd < dIJ) { dist[idx2(j, i, n)] = nd; path[idx2(j, i, n)] = k; }\n            }\n}\n\nint main() {\n    const size_t sizes[] = {1, 2, 3, 15, 31, 32, 33, 47, 63, 64, 65, 100, 129, 200, 257, 300, 511, 512, 513, 700, 1000};\n    const unsigned weights[] = {1, 2, 3, 10, 200};\n    int fails = 0, runs = 0;\n    for (size_t n : sizes) {\n        for (unsigned W : weights) {\n            for (unsigned seed = 1; ++i) d[i] = 1 + rng() % W;\n                for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) d[idx2(i, i, n)] = 0;\n                initializePathMatrix(p, n);\n                dg = d; pg = p;\n                refFW(d, p, n);\n                floydWarshall(dg, pg, n);\n                ++runs;\n                if (d != dg || p != pg) {\n                    size_t bad = 0;\n                    for (size_t i = 0;
